ios.desc:
Understand the news from more than one side.

Drooid brings different perspectives on the same story into one place. Catch up with concise, AI-assisted summaries, then explore Left, Center and Right perspectives to see how the framing changes. See where accounts agree, where they diverge, and what deserves a closer look.

Follow the source links to read the original reporting for yourself. When a headline leaves you with questions, Full Breakdown offers deeper background and analysis on supported stories, helping you understand how events unfolded and why they matter.

See beyond one side. Make up your own mind.

Unlimited reading is available with an optional Drooid Pro subscription.

android.desc:
Read daily news from more than one side.

Drooid brings world news, US politics and local news together in concise summaries. Compare how left, center and right outlets cover the same story, then open the original reporting to explore further.

Built for readers seeking an unbiased news app, Drooid is a news aggregator that makes coverage comparison and source checking part of your reading.

Compare news coverage across different sides
News comparison helps you see where reporting overlaps and where the framing changes. Read the perspectives available on a story and notice which facts, voices or consequences receive attention. For readers looking for unbiased political news, comparing the coverage gives you a way to examine the reporting for yourself.

Follow world news and politics
Follow US news and election news alongside international news. Explore geopolitics through the stories covered on Drooid, and compare how outlets explain current events. Look at the reporting behind world events before forming your own view.

Read local news in a wider context
Find local stories covered on Drooid alongside national news. A local decision can become a national debate; a world event can affect a community closer to home. Compare the available coverage and follow the source links when you want to explore the details.

Catch up with short news summaries
Use Drooid as a daily news digest when you want a concise overview. Browse the news feed for a quick catch-up, or search for a story or topic you want to understand. Start with a short summary, then choose which perspectives and original articles to read next.

Follow breaking news with context
Read news updates on developing stories alongside the reporting behind them. Compare the perspectives available as a story unfolds, and use the original sources to check what each outlet is reporting.

Go deeper with Full Breakdown
On supported stories, open Full Breakdown for more detail, news analysis and historical context. Move beyond the initial news summary when you want to understand the events, people and decisions behind the headline. Depth is there when you want it, without making every catch-up a long read.

Check the news sources
See which outlets contributed to the coverage and open links to their original articles. Where available, source information includes political bias and reliability ratings to help you examine media bias. These details give you more context for judging the reporti

quotes.text:
I was bothered by heavy polarization of Americans, individually and even in churches, that appears to ve driven mostly by media outlets who cherry pick and lie. The Left and Right report specific events so differently that their readers might as well live in different worlds. People need to ditch those sources where possible. If not, they need to have a mix of them while understanding their biases.

Originally for churches, my draft article below describes how this problem affects all individuals and institutions. I recommend solutions which include AllSides.com (amazing!) and search engines for retrieving news from multiple outlets. I have a prototype. Progress is slow on my tool because I work two jobs with my free time mostly going to ministry serving Christ and others.

https://heswithjesus.com/mediabias.html

I haven't finished reviewing and adding Drooid yet. I'll still link it because it's a good idea:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/drooid-news-from-all-sides/id6593684010

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=social.drooid&hl=en-US

(Note: I'm not affiliated with or paid by any of these companies. I am a paying supported of AllSides because I believe they'll do a lot of good.)

quotes.text:
The Problem:

Social media platforms such as X, Facebook, and Reddit have become the primary news sources for most individuals. These platforms are designed to maximize engagement and provide information that reinforces existing biases. The mass adoption of these platforms has contributed to highly polarized societies and widespread misinformation and hate.

Drooid’s Approach:

Drooid tackles misinformation and bias by providing all sides of news stories. It gathers articles from various journalistic sources, processes them, and then generates short news summaries, around 60 words, which cover all sides, left, right, and center. Whenever possible, Drooid provides a short historical context with them.

To give the complete picture faster, Drooid avoids overwhelming with excessive information. However, there is an In-depth news analysis feature to help you understand in detail "what exactly happened," "how different stakeholders are affected," "how they reacted," and "how various news reports contradict each other," and a lot more.

On Drooid, you’re not just a passive reader; you can comment, share how you feel, and add context. Every comment appears in a community feed. You can read others' comments on news stories. With this, news becomes humane, not just facts and reports.

For full transparency, every summary links back to the original articles. Making it easy to read and share original articles. It serves two purposes: readers get to know where the information is coming …
